Here are the descriptions of the provided plots, following your guidelines:

The plot illustrates the training loss for several models over a series of training steps. The x-axis is labeled “Step” and has a linear scale, ranging from 0k to 440k, with tick labels at 0k, 20k, 40k, 60k, 80k, 420k, 430k, and 440k. The y-axis is labeled “Train Loss” and has a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 0.85, with tick labels at 0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8. The first line, representing “ChemBART Small 20M”, is red and solid, starting at approximately 0.76 at 0k and decreasing to approximately 0.08 at 440k. The second line, representing “ChemBART Medium 20M”, is green and solid, starting at approximately 0.76 at 0k and decreasing to approximately 0.06 at 440k. The third line, representing “ChemBERTa Medium 20M”, is orange and solid, starting at approximately 0.76 at 0k and decreasing to approximately 0.07 at 440k. The fourth line, representing “ChemLLaMA Small 20M”, is purple and solid, starting at approximately 0.76 at 0k and decreasing to approximately 0.09 at 440k. The fifth line, representing “ChemLLaMA Medium 20M”, is brown and solid, starting at approximately 0.76 at 0k and decreasing to approximately 0.07 at 440k.
